# Pinned ARM f32 dot-product reference

`arm-f32.json` records 39 calls to exported `ggml_vec_dot_f32` in the unchanged
pinned llama.cpp CPU library. Reference commit, library SHA-256 and source
capture SHA-256 are recorded in the JSON. Inputs and expected results are u32
f32 bit patterns, so JSON decimal conversion cannot alter rounding cases.

Cases cover lengths 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 15, 16, 17, 31, 32, 33, 63, 64, 65,
127, 128 and 129 with two deterministic patterns, plus a captured 64-element
Q/K pair at Arabic decode position 15. The reference was called through ctypes
with nrc=1 and zero unused strides, after verifying all reference build-stamp
file hashes. Expected values are not generated by Ember.

Local evidence: `dot-reference-fixture/generate.py`, `generation.log` and
`before.log`. The pre-change ARM implementation fails the pattern length-2 case
by one f32 step. The exact fixture test is scoped to macOS AArch64, where this
reference was collected. Other architectures need their own validation.
